svg.title: TPU core architecture
svg.desc: Block diagram of the 8x8 systolic array TPU core, showing host interface, control FSM, weight and unified buffers feeding the systolic array, the drain chain through accumulator, bias add, two pipeline registers, and the activation mux, with a feedback loop from the write-back mux back to the unified buffer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the host interface look like and what control signals does it expose?')
g.text: cmd / start / done / write and read ports

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the control FSM step through COMPUTE, DRAIN, STORE, and CLEAR?')
sendPrompt('What does the configuration interface configure?')
sendPrompt('How does the weight buffer use double-buffering to avoid stalling the array?')
sendPrompt('What does the unified buffer transposed copy do and why is it needed?')
sendPrompt('How does the 8x8 systolic array work — weight loading, activation streaming, and psum propagation?')
sendPrompt('How does the accumulator handle multi-pass tiling for matrices larger than 8x8?')
sendPrompt('How does bias_add work — where do biases live and when is the addition performed?')
sendPrompt('Why is this pipeline register here — what does it do for timing closure?')
sendPrompt('What activation functions are supported and how are they selected?')
sendPrompt('Why is this pipeline register here — what stage does it terminate?')
sendPrompt('What does the write-back mux select between, and how does the FSM control it?')
